title: T23 contract: theme packs in the format doc (0.5.0)
head: t23-themes
body:
Theme packs in the format doc (T23, decisions #77, #78) and the cross-repo contract every T23 builder reads.

## What
- `docs/formats.md`: new "Theme pack — theme.yaml" section (colors with required `light` + `dark`, type, radius, motion, sounds; 34 tokens mapped to the app's real `--oasis-*` properties; WCAG AA pairs) and optional `theme:` in profile.yaml (default `lantern`).
- `docs/t23/contract.md`: playbooks owns the validator + contrast checker; agent-core profile field, routes mirroring the avatar ones, `~/.oasis/themes/` cache; desktop live token switch, picker on the Coworkers page; tests and mutants per repo. §8 settled provisionally (#159).
- 0.4.2 → 0.5.0, CHANGELOG.

## Checks
<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check
No ask-first gate or state mapping: docs and version only. The contrast check, missing-dark, unknown-id and live-switch mutants run in the playbooks, agent-core and desktop-app T23 PRs.
